stories.title: 網紅 Mika 誤貼私鑰，$MIKA 開發錢包被掃約 $4 萬
stories.title_en: Crypto Influencer Mika Accidentally Posts Private Key, Loses $40K
stories.summary: 10/28 發幣時貼錯私鑰，約 5 億枚 $MIKA 秒被搬走換約 380 SOL（~$4 萬）。鏈上量急升急跌，社區爭論係失手定操作。
stories.summary_en: During an Oct 28 memecoin launch, influencer Mika pasted a private key; ~500M $MIKA (~380 SOL / $38–40K) drained in seconds.
stories.why_it_matters: 紙上跟買亦要當私鑰／合約地址係高風險；名人發幣唔等於安全，合約同金鑰操作失誤會即時爆倉。

stories.title: $LAUNCH 一小時由 $4M 跌到 ~$10 萬，疑似 rug
stories.title_en: $LAUNCH Crashes from $4M to $100K in One Hour
stories.summary: Solana launchpad uselaunch.fun 代幣 10/28 急崩；鏈上兩錢包提前套現，官帳同網站隨後消失，社區指 rug。
stories.summary_en: $LAUNCH for uselaunch.fun fell ~$4M→$100–200K on Oct 28; two wallets cashed out early; X/site vanished after a 'giving up' post.
stories.why_it_matters: 新 launchpad 幣極易一日內歸零；模擬倉跟買應避開「平台幣／自家盤」同開發者可任意撤帳嘅項目。

stories.title: Calacanis 稱 Bitcoin「死網絡」，粉絲開出 $300 萬對賭
stories.title_en: Jason Calacanis Calls Bitcoin Dead Network; $3M Betting Challenges
stories.summary: 10/28 BTC 約 $81k（離高位低約 35%），Calacanis 預測 12 個月內到 $57k；Cardone 等各開 $100 萬對賭會再創新高。
stories.summary_en: With BTC near $81k, Calacanis called it a dead network and eyed $57k in 12 months; fans offered ~$3M in public bets it reclaims ATH.
stories.why_it_matters: 大盤情緒同 BTC 趨勢直接影響弱市閘同半注規則；跟買批次要睇 breadth／BTC 24h，唔好當名人言論係入場信號。

stories.title: 大選後傳 Netanyahu 或推「Bibicoin」Solana meme
stories.title_en: Rumors of Netanyahu Memecoin After Close Election
stories.summary: 以色列大選後網上熱傳「Bibicoin」；對照 $TRUMP 先例，但官方未確認，低市值仿盤已有。
stories.summary_en: After close election tallies, talk of a Netanyahu Solana memecoin spiked; parallels to $TRUMP, no confirmation, low-cap clones already exist.
stories.why_it_matters: 政治名人幣波動極大、仿盤眾多；紙上實驗可觀察，但唔適合當 AI 主推跟買。

stories.title: 12 平台數據：平均 88.5% 交易者蝕錢
stories.title_en: 88.5% of Crypto Traders Lose Money Across 12 Platforms
stories.summary: 涵蓋約 3500 萬用戶，Pump.fun 蝕錢率約 97%、Binance Futures 約 80%；開發者從 Pump.fun 幣抽走約 $5.79 億。
stories.summary_en: Across 12 venues (~35M users) avg loss rate 88.5% (Pump.fun ~97%, Binance Futures ~80%); ~$579M pulled by devs from Pump.fun tokens.
stories.why_it_matters: 驗證我哋「假錢紙上倉」實驗嘅價值：用真實行情量度 AI 跟買勝率，先於真倉。

stories.title: Predict.fun 第三方文件被入侵，約 40 萬 USDT 被掃
stories.title_en: Predict.fun Hit by Unauthorized Wallet Drains (~400k USDT)
stories.summary: 10/27 約 29 個連結錢包被掃；平台指第三方 API 文件站注入惡意腳本，承諾賠償，核心合約聲稱未中招。
stories.summary_en: ~400k USDT drained from 29 wallets via compromised third-party API docs; Predict.fun pledged reimbursements; core contracts said intact.
stories.why_it_matters: 連結錢包／第三方文件都係攻擊面；模擬倉用戶亦應避免隨意授權不明 DApp。

stories.title: BNB Chain 代幣化資產 Q3 供應近 $50 億
stories.title_en: BNB Chain Tokenized Assets Surge in Q3 2026
stories.summary: RWA 供應升約 24% 至 $49.6 億；代幣化股票借貸爆發，持有人數由約 50 萬跳到 530 萬。
stories.summary_en: BNB Chain RWA supply +24% to $4.96B in Q3; tokenized equity lending surged; holders ~502k→5.3M.
stories.why_it_matters: CEX／公鏈叙事轉移會改變熱錢流向；爆升表應繼續分開「現貨急升」同「長線叙事幣」。

stories.title: Binance 向巴西央行申請加密牌照
stories.title_en: Binance Applies for Brazil Crypto License
stories.summary: 經 BBrasil 申請；巴西用戶已限制貸款／槓桿，並下架 22 個幣，現貨同穩定幣暫保留。
stories.summary_en: Binance filed via BBrasil; restricted loans/margin and delisted 22 tokens for BR users while spot/stables continue during review.
stories.why_it_matters: 監管落地會改變可交易池；我哋紙上盤只跟 Binance 公開 USDT 現貨，要留意下架名單。

stories.title: Litecoin 發「Doge 寶寶」雞圖，帶起一輪 meme
stories.title_en: Litecoin Posts Fluffy Chicken as Dogecoin Baby
stories.summary: 官方 X 貼 Chikun／Doge 聯動圖，社區喊 Arise Chikun；鏈上出現 Dogecock、CHIMKEM、LITEDOGE 等跟風幣。
stories.summary_en: Litecoin's official account posted a Chikun×Doge baby meme; fans revived Arise Chikun; copycat memecoins launched quickly.
stories.why_it_matters: 官帳 meme 可短暫帶熱；跟風幣多數一日幣，唔應入 AI 主推表。
